text: Last updated: July 31, 2023 *Including city-wide amendments up to April 1, 2024
This office consolidation includes all Ontario Land Tribunal/Local Planning Appeal Tribunal/Ontario Municipal Board (OLT/LPAT/OMB) decisions issued up to the date of consolidation.
The portions of this By-law that are highlighted bright yellow were originally enacted by City Council May 9, 2013 and are under appeal to the OLT/LPAT/OMB and are not in full force and effect.
The portions of this By-law that are shaded dark yellow identify amendments enacted by City Council after May 9, 2013 which are under appeal to the OLT/LPAT/OMB and are not in full force and effect.
The portions of this By-law that are shaded blue identify amendments enacted by City Council after May 9, 2013 which are not in full force and effect.
ORIGINALLY ENACTED BY CITY COUNCIL May 9, 2013
The following zoning by-law amendments have been enacted by City Council or the OLT/LPAT/OMB but are not yet incorporated into the office consolidation of By-law 569-2013:
1043-2015 - 270-288 Church Street, 101-105 Bond Street and 111 Bond Street
1358-2015 - 33 King Street, 22 John Street and 2 Elsmere Avenue
758-2016 - 11 and 33 Centre Avenue and 80 Chestnut Street
269-2019 – 125, 129 and 131 O'Connor Drive and 1119 and 1121 Pape Avenue
1011-2020(LPAT) – 250 Lawrence Avenue West and 219 Glengarry Avenue
1009-2022 - 25 Sewells Road and 182 to 250 Brenyon Way
1279-2022(OLT) - 214 Soudan Avenue (including 214-226 Soudan Avenue and 19- 21 Brownlow Avenue)
Any zoning by law amendment enacted after July 31, 2023 or not appearing on the By-law Status Registry as of July 31, 2023

The following city-wide zoning by-law amendments have been enacted by City Council between August 1, 2023 and April 1, 2024 and have been incorporated into the office consolidation of By-law 569-2013:
256-2024 – To Amend By-law 156-2023 to Permit Multi-Tenant Houses
1153-2023 – Outdoor Patios Located on Private Property
1268-2023 – Correction of Typographical Errors and Omissions and to Correct
1313-2023 – To Simplify and Update Regulations in Low-rise Residential Zones
